paper_metadata.title: Factores clínicos y psicosociales asociados al control de crisis en pacientes con epilepsia mioclónica juvenil

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study clearly defines the source population and inclusion/exclusion criteria. However, it is a single-center study at a specialized reference center, which may introduce selection bias as patients at tertiary centers often have more severe disease than the general population. The participation rate of eligible individuals from the initial cohort is not fully transparent.

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study requires a 12-month follow-up for inclusion, which inherently excludes those lost to follow-up early. The authors admit that many patients were excluded due to incomplete information or insufficient follow-up, but they do not provide a flow diagram or comparison between included and excluded patients.
